source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The preprint studies hidden recanting witnesses with proxy-based identification strategies, semiparametric inference, and an NLSY97 application.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1785, Section 4, Theorem 1; pp. 1787-1788, Section 5 and Algorithm 3 discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Algorithm 2 creates an equivalent polynomial program and Theorem 1 gives sharp causal bounds; Algorithm 3 is a spatial branch-and-bound procedure tracking epsilon-sharpness.
The paper relates a Hellinger modulus for a scalar functional T(F) to minimax estimation and composite testing under stated scalar-functional settings.
The paper constructs asymptotically valid, including uniform, confidence regions for identified sets and their images under a known function.

source_verification_receipts.version: SIAM Journal on Numerical Analysis 13(4), 1976, pp. 497-513
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes a linearization-based condition sufficient, and under an added hypothesis necessary, for stability of nonlinear inequality-system solution sets under perturbation.
For a class of partially identified regions, the paper establishes Hausdorff and directed-Hausdorff asymptotics and associated confidence collections.
The paper develops confidence regions for inequality-defined identified sets, uses directed-Hausdorff/Wald methods, and proves root-n Hausdorff consistency under its regularity conditions.
The preprint develops exact p-values and confidence intervals for real-valued functions of multinomial probability parameters.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the projected-calmness frontier the headline and prove a graph-specific, observable criterion or sharp Holder exponent on a nondegenerate positive-cell stratum; this is the route that can turn the generic minimax wrapper into a field-level causal result.

Add BeresteanuMolinari2008 and ChernozhukovKocatulumMenzel2015, state their exact directed-Hausdorff/root-n results, and prove precisely why their regular smooth-set regimes do not subsume the nonconvex semialgebraic causal image.
Replace target_estimand verbatim with the already defined psi(S), or define every nested counterfactual and preserve Y's four arguments consistently throughout.

recommended_next_step: Revise before Stage 0: repair the target notation, add and distinguish the omitted directed-set literature, and elevate a graph-specific singular-modulus result beyond the generic set-valued Le Cam extension.
